parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: ConnectType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:

- slb

- eni

parameters.name: MseVersion
parameters.description:
The MSE cluster version to be activated.

- mse\_pro: Professional Edition.

- mse\_dev: Developer Edition.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the cluster is located, regions supported by MSE.
